_meta.note: Decision ("System One") models. Independent results from the community Jev Decision Index (HF Space JSON, text board 0.3.1 + vision board 0.3.1); vendor/repo self-reported results kept on source-prefixed ids (cloudflare_*, fastino_*, plus repo ids); Raschka IMDb own experiments. Text rows verified against page text; chart-image rows checked by eye. Anonymous board entrants without repo/org not registered.

models.name: Jev 1.13
models._note: TypeSafe AI decision ("System One") model: returns typed answers (probabilities, choices, numbers) instead of generated text; API only (jev-latest → jev-1.13.0). Launch post "Introducing System One Models & Jev" 2026-09-15; release date from the OrcaRouter catalogue listing of Jev 1.13 (2026-09-24). Also used as a zero-shot guardrail (Red Hat EvalHub, S300).
